create_conv1d_layer: create a Conv1D layer with specified output channels and kernel shape for 1D convolution
create_conv2d_layer: create a Conv2D layer with output channels and kernel shape for 2D image convolution
create_conv3d_layer: create a Conv3D layer with output channels and kernel shape for 3D volumetric data convolution
create_conv_transpose_layer: create a Conv2DTranspose layer for upsampling with specified output channels and kernel shape
configure_group_convolution: configure a Conv2D layer with feature_group_count for grouped convolution to reduce parameters
